ideas.title: Minnesota's Decades-Long Fraud Problem
ideas.description: Investigate the history of fraud in Minnesota and the role of state officials in ignoring warnings
ideas.angle: Follow the money and track the impact on the state's budget
questions: What were the warnings ignored by state officials?
How much has fraud cost the state of Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to reveal a decades-long pattern of neglect and corruption in Minnesota's government. By following the money and tracking the impact on the state's budget, we can expose the truth behind the state's fraud problem.
